'''Idriono''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], Idriono also provided the knowledge of synthweaving to others.
